query:
WITH requested(id) AS (
                   SELECT DISTINCT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM json_each(?)
               )
               SELECT r.id AS "sentence_id!: i64",
                      g.label AS "label!: String",
                      g.first_sentence AS "first_sentence!: i64",
                      g.end_sentence AS "end_sentence!: i64"
               FROM requested r
               JOIN regions g ON g.first_sentence<=r.id AND g.end_sentence>r.id
               ORDER BY r.id,g.label,g.first_sentence,g.end_sentence
